'''Anything Goes''' is a constructed [[GEMP]] environment on [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]<ref name="play" />: every set is legal, the collection is the player's constructed card pool, and the intended deck size is 40&ndash;60 cards. Its definition calls it the default format for casual and AI play.<ref name="gemp" /> Casual tables and AI tables on this instance are meant to default to this environment. [[Open]] stays in the format list for current-virtual constructed play.

* '''Type:''' casual
* '''Defined by:''' play.swccg.com
* '''Card pool:''' Decipher, current virtual and Legacy virtual sets, 40&ndash;60 cards
* '''In use:''' unknown
* '''GEMP:''' ''Anything Goes'' (<code>anything_goes</code>) on play.swccg.com; none on the Players Committee GEMP

== Card pool ==
The format allows Decipher set ids 1&ndash;14 and premium ids 101&ndash;112, current Virtual Sets 0&ndash;27 (ids 200&ndash;227), the Virtual Premium Set (id 301), and the set numbers that the [[Legacy Open|Legacy]] format uses (601 and 1200&ndash;1292). The definition's comment calls this "Legacy plus non-Legacy".<ref name="gemp" /> A deck must have at least 40 and at most 60 cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="lib" />

The definition sets <code>skipFormatPool</code>. A card must still come from a listed set, but GEMP then skips the format's checks for banned icons, banned rarities and banned cards.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="dsf" />

Structural checks still apply. A list with both Light and Dark cards, no side, more than one [[Objective]], more than one Starting Effect, uniqueness violations, or unrecognizable cards does not start a game.

== History ==
Anything Goes exists only on play.swccg.com; the Players Committee format list does not have it.<ref name="gemp" /><ref name="pc-gemp" /> Further work for this environment (same-side tables, true any-size lists, empty Reserve / short-hand autoloss, and account-stored settings) is listed on [[GEMP planned features]]. No tournament is known to have used it.
